image: So the noble one sorts high from low
lines: The road trodden, level and level.
The hidden one, holding firm: good.
One-eyed, and sees; lame, and treads.
Treading the tiger's tail: it bites. Misfortune.
A fighting man acting the great ruler.
Look at the treading, examine its signs.
As it turns back: great good.

notes.name_en: 履 is treading/stepping throughout; the verb as title.
notes.L3: 眇/跛 one-eyed and lame overreach their powers; 武人 a fighting man usurping the ruler's part.
